subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful after-compaction hooks receive current-session reset authority across the built-in OpenClaw, bundled Codex, and bundled Copilot harnesses?
rationale: This introduces a destructive plugin-facing operation and selectively passes private lifecycle authority across harness ownership boundaries; tests cannot determine the permanent supported security and plugin contract.

options.title: Approve narrow hook authority
options.body: Expose only the deferred current-session API after successful, unlocked compaction and retain strict bundled-harness ownership checks.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the plugin hook API and let only core lifecycle owners or an owner plugin contract decide when sessions rotate.

options.title: Design a general reset API
options.body: Replace this narrow contract with a separately reviewed permissioned plugin API covering reset scope, compatibility, throttling, and documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook authority
recommendation.body: Expose only the deferred current-session API after successful, unlocked compaction and retain strict bundled-harness ownership checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows the strongest recent ownership signal on the adjacent persisted-session and upgrade boundary.
